title: The Overpaid Cheque
intro: A new "employer" sent you a cheque that is too big. They ask you to send back the difference.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Cheque sent. Please return the extra…

p: Welcome to the team! Your first cheque is on its way:

p.text: send me £900 back by bank transfer
equipment you will buy from my supplier
Do this today so I can start your training.

addr.label: A free-mail address
addr.lens: A real business writes from its own address.
addr.why: Look at the address behind the name.

amount.label: A cheque before any work
amount.lens: You are paid before you do a thing.
amount.why: Real employers do not pay a big cheque in advance.

over.label: "£900 too much"
over.lens: An overpayment to be sent back.
over.why: A cheque that is too big, with a request to return the difference, is a classic trick.

back.label: "Send me £900 back"
back.lens: You send real money, then the cheque bounces.
back.why: The cheque is fake. Your transfer is real. You lose the full amount.

equip.label: Equipment from "my supplier"
equip.lens: You are told where to spend.
equip.why: A supplier chosen by the "employer" is part of the trick.

actions.label: Deposit the cheque and send £900 back
Do not send anything, and ask my bank if the cheque has really cleared
Do not send anything. Report the email

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. The fake address was blocked.

verify.line: Your bank said the cheque looked fake and had not cleared. You sent nothing and lost nothing. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The cheque bounced a week later. The £900 you sent was real, and the bank took the cheque's amount back.

what_if.go_ahead: Any request to send part of a cheque back is the scam. A bank showing a deposit does not mean the cheque has cleared.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Never send money back from a cheque. A deposit that appears in your account may bounce days later.

quick_check.q: An "employer" sends a cheque too big and asks you to send back the difference. What do you do?

options.text: Send it back, it is their mistake
Do not send anything. It is a scam
Wait a day and then send it

quick_check.explain: A cheque can be fake even when the bank shows it. The overpayment is the trick.

hints.nudge: What happens to the cheque after you send real money?

rows.k: A cheque and a request to send part back
rows.v: A scam: the cheque is fake

rows.k: Do not rely on a cheque
rows.v: Until your bank confirms the funds are fully available
